points.description: States a valid advantage of TiC/TiN coating, such as excellent wear resistance, thermal stability, or low coefficient of friction.
points.partial_credit: Half if the advantage is vague, e.g. 'makes the tool better' or 'hard' without linking to wear or tool performance.

points.description: Gives a consequence or second valid advantage, such as increased tool life, improved thermal transfer, or reduced friction/heat, stated in connection with the coating.
points.partial_credit: Half if stated vaguely or with a minor error.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for a valid advantage from the model answer (wear resistance, thermal stability, low friction, better thermal transfer, longer tool life) stated clearly with an explanation or second related benefit. Give 1 mark if only one valid advantage is given with little detail, or the idea is vague. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers, such as saying the coating lowers hardness.
